# Adhar

> Adhar is a lightweight backend framework for JSON APIs on Node.js: folder-based routes under `/api`, plain handler functions that return the response, folder middleware, a small schema validator, auto-injected services and the built-in SQLite database. A project with a `web/` folder is full stack: an Alo site served on the same port as the API. Zero dependencies. Requires Node.js 22.13+. It is the backend sibling of the Alo static site framework.

If you write code for an Adhar project, read the AI guide first. It lists the rules and the mistakes AI assistants make most often (Adhar is not Express, Koa, Hono or Next.js).

- [AI guide (rules for AI assistants)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msilabs/adhar/main/templates/init/AGENTS.md): hard rules, project layout, ctx, schema, middleware, services, database, commands
- [README (Bengali)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msilabs/adhar/main/README.md): full user documentation
- [Full specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msilabs/adhar/main/docs/SPEC.md): every rule in detail
- [Design decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/msilabs/adhar/main/DECISIONS.md): why Adhar behaves the way it does
